fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.pal: A Villager profession, uniquely qualified for paleontological digs.
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.gli:
A Passive beast that can be tamed with pufferfish and bred with Salmon. 

When they hear music, they dance with aplomb shedding vibrant feathers.
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.eat:
An ancient apex predator, this neutral beast will attack and chase away any potential threat with it's iron jaws.

It hunts animals, scares mobs, and will sometimes drop it's teeth and become enraged after feeding. Its roars are paralyzing.
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.cru:
An agitatable neutral beast, Crushers will headbutt anything they can, which is everything. Using a chisel can help remove a Spike, at the cost of creating a very angry Crusher....

It can be bred with Hanging Roots.
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.tox:
An exceptionally rare fish found in the depts of Swampy and warm environments. It can be stored in a bucket.

When threatened, it will create a cloud of noxious gasses.
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.sur:
A passive and rather skiddish beast with a seafaring lifestyle, the Surfer feeds on coral and adapts to the colors they harbor.

It it tamed with Coral Fans and bred with Sea Pickles. It can be saddled, or even equipped with armor made of scutes.

It's a reliable surfing companion!
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.wal:
A titanic, passive beast tamed when young with Spore Blossoms, Walkers are more than kind enough to offer a ride to up to 4 players. 
They can also holster massive chests on their sides.

They can be bred with Spore Blossoms and healed with Azalea Leaves.
fieldguide.entity.wan_ancient_beasts.soa:
A large, flying, neutral beast. It loves to eat Toxlacanth and breeds with Pufferfish, being highly resistant to poisons.

Feeding it Toxlacanth will tame it, Where it can then be saddled, ridden and commanded to attack.

It will eventually tire, though.
